comments.text: The staff screen in User interface and its lifecycle (new, contacted, closed) have no requirement of their own; only the visitor page is covered by R1-R4. Consider adding one requirement for staff moving a lead request through its statuses, with a criterion, so the screen's behaviour is verified and not only its existence.
Added R5/A5 for the staff list order; the status flow is a table-carried lifecycle, so it gets no requirement of its own.

Not a defect on its own, but R3 and A3 only cover empty full name and invalid email; the form's required fields are never listed anywhere in the spec (the page form is explicitly not tied to LeadRequest), so 'required field' and 'valid' are undefined for the tester. List the form's fields, which are required, and whether the request type (test drive / quote) is chosen on the form.
R2/R3 now list the form's fields, which are required, and that request type is chosen on the form; A2/A3 use concrete inputs.

text: IN: a screen where staff keep lead requests (entered by hand through its form).

comments.text: Blocking: The staff screen and its state flow (new to contacted to closed) are in scope and described in the User interface section, but no requirement or acceptance criterion covers it. Add a requirement stating the one behaviour that matters (e.g. staff can move a request through new, contacted, closed, list newest first) and a testable criterion, or the screen is built without any verification.
Covered by R5/A5 (newest first); status moves are the bean's lifecycle field.
